_comment: The one place the controller's transaction-log store address lives. Read by BOTH languages:
PowerShell via Get-TransactionLogStore (tools/shared/cluster-utils.ps1) and Node via
tools/tests/testkit/log-query.mjs. JSON because it is the only format both read natively with
no build step and no parser to keep in sync.
Each side keeps its OWN small reader — the drift incident that made Get-TransactionLogStore
declare itself 'The ONE path' was duplicated LOGIC (one copy carried a 2>&1 that corrupted the
JSON), not a duplicated constant. What must not diverge is the address and the read rule, and

transactionLogStore.readRule: docker exec <container> cat <path> — NEVER merge stderr (2>&1). Docker's stderr warnings interleave into the JSON and break the parse; the exit code is the success signal. Use argv (no sh -c) unless globbing is required.
transactionLogStore.shape: A JSON array. Each element: { transferId, transferInfo, summary, events, savedAt }.

instanceScriptOutput.note: debug_* dumps are written ONLY when the plugin's debug_mode is on (module/utils/debug-export.lua). A missing dump is an operational condition, never evidence that a value is absent.
